query: 2026 gubernatorial debates scheduled summer 2026 Pennsylvania Shapiro Garrity, Oregon Kotek Drazan, Arizona Hobbs, Wisconsin - any debate before September 2026
answer:
Research complete. Summary of the core finding:

**No 2026 general-election gubernatorial debate has been held or scheduled before September in any of the four states.** Every mutually-confirmed debate falls in October:

- **Pennsylvania** — nothing scheduled at all. Both campaigns said in June they'd do "at least one"; Garrity demanded seven (one per media market); Shapiro's team refused to negotiate publicly. No date/host/format as of Aug 19. Base rate is stark: zero debates in 2022, one in 2018.
- **Oregon** — Kotek declined the July 24 ONPA event that traditionally opens debate season (Drazan appeared solo). The two agreed debates are Oct 1 (Eugene, tentative) and Oct 7 (KOBI Medford, confirmed). Two September events exist — KPTV/law-enforcement and the Sept 24 OBI forum — but only Drazan has accepted them.
- **Arizona** — Hobbs refused all debates on July 30. The Clean Elections calendar, published back in April, always had Governor on Oct 6; the first statewide general debate of any kind is Aug 31 (Mine Inspector).
- **Wisconsin** — nominees only settled Aug 11. As of Aug 18 neither Crowley nor Tiffany had committed to anything; TMJ4 (Oct 8) and Wisconsin Broadcasters Association (Oct 9) are proposals.

Nationally the pattern holds — the earliest confirmed general-election governor debate anywhere is South Dakota's State Fair debate during Sept 2–7. The closest pre-September cross-party event was Minnesota's Aug 5 Farmfest forum, but that was pre-primary and not a two-nominee debate.

One caveat on data vintage: Pennsylvania's debate-specific reporting is ~2 months stale (last substantive coverage June 23–27), so it's the state where a quiet development is most likely to have gone unreported.

sources.title: Shapiro and Garrity open to a 2026 PA governor debate
sources.snippet: Spokespeople for incumbent Democratic Gov. Josh Shapiro and Republican challenger Stacy Garrity told Spotlight PA that the candidates are both willing to participate in at least one debate leading up to November's general election. 'We aren't going to negotiate the terms of a debate through the press,' said Manuel Bonder, Shapiro's spokesperson.

sources.title: Garrity Calls For Seven Debates vs. Shapiro
sources.snippet: The Garrity campaign's plan is for one debate to be conducted in each of the Commonwealth's seven media markets, including Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Harrisburg-Lancaster-Lebanon-York, Johnstown-Altoona, Wilkes-Barre-Scranton, Erie and Binghamton, N.Y. Published June 23, 2026.

sources.title: Garrity calls for 7 debates with Shapiro in Pa. governor's race
sources.snippet: It is unlikely that Shapiro would agree to more than one debate because he has a considerable lead in recent polling and frontrunners typically avoid settings that might induce gaffes. The last gubernatorial debate was in 2018 between Gov. Tom Wolf and former GOP state Sen. Scott Wagner, hosted by the late 'Jeopardy' host Alex Trebek.

sources.title: Shapiro, Garrity say they are willing to debate in race for Pa. governor
sources.snippet: Garrity spokesman Matt Beynon said Tuesday that the two campaigns had not yet started trying to work out details for potential debates, including how many might be held and their format. In 2022, Shapiro and Mastriano did not participate in any debates.

sources.title: Shapiro and Garrity both say they're willing to debate in this year's Pa. gov race
sources.snippet: The last time Pennsylvanians saw their gubernatorial candidates debate was in 2018, when then-Gov. Tom Wolf met GOP nominee Scott Wagner at that year's Pennsylvania Chamber of Business & Industry's dinner for their sole debate of the campaign.

sources.title: Home - Pennsylvania Chamber Dinner (42nd Annual, Oct 5, 2026)
sources.snippet: Kevin Hart will serve as the keynote speaker at the PA Chamber's top signature event on Monday, October 5, 2026, at the Hershey Lodge. No gubernatorial debate announced on the 2026 program.

sources.title: 42nd PA Chamber Annual Dinner on October 5 to Feature Global Superstar Kevin Hart
sources.snippet: Global superstar, comedian, and entrepreneur Kevin Hart will be our keynote speaker at the 42nd PA Chamber Annual Dinner on Monday, October 5, 2026, at the Hershey Lodge.

sources.title: Kotek, Drazan will face off in 2 Oregon governor October debates
sources.snippet: Both candidates have agreed to two October debates. Drazan and Kotek will debate Oct. 7 on KOBI in Medford. Another, hosted by the Oregon Journalism Project, University of Oregon School of Journalism and Communication and KEZI in Eugene is tentatively scheduled for Oct. 1. Drazan's campaign declined a third debate with KOIN in Portland.

sources.title: Kotek, Drazan to face off in live KOBI-TV Gubernatorial debate
sources.snippet: MEDFORD, Ore. - Democratic Gov. Tina Kotek and Republican candidate State Sen. Christine Drazan have both agreed to take the stage in Medford on Wednesday, Oct. 7. The one-hour broadcast will run from 7 p.m. to 8 p.m., moderated by Salem Bureau Chief Craig Smullin. Published July 30, 2026.

sources.title: Oregon Gubernatorial Debate, Wednesday, October 7th at 7:00pm
sources.snippet: KOBI-TV/NBC5 will host a live debate between Democratic Oregon Governor Tina Kotek and Republican State Senator Christine Drazan on Wednesday, October 7th, 2026, from 7:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. Press release dated July 31, 2026.

sources.title: Kotek declines first Oregon governor debate ahead of November election
sources.snippet: Gov. Tina Kotek has declined a July Oregon Newspaper Publishers Association gubernatorial debate with Sen. Christine Drazan, despite participating in 2022. ONPA Executive Director Laurie Hieb said she 'was disappointed they declined as our debate is traditionally the kick off to debate season.' The debate was set for the Salem Convention Center on July 24. Published June 18, 2026.

sources.title: What Kotek, Drazan are saying 100 days from Oregon governor election
sources.snippet: The ONPA event was intended to be a debate, but Kotek opted out, despite participating in 2022. She ultimately spent the day in Sisters for the Akawa Butte Fire. Kotek challenged Drazan to three debates in Portland, Eugene and Medford, beginning in September. The dates of those events have not yet been announced.

sources.title: Governor Tina Kotek Schedules Three Debates for Eugene, Medford and Portland Area
sources.snippet: The Tina for Oregon campaign announced commitments to three debates in Eugene/Springfield, Medford, and the Portland area, hosted by the Oregon Journalism Project, KOBI, and KOIN respectively. The debates have not yet all been formally accepted by Christine Drazan.

sources.title: RELEASE: Governor Tina Kotek Challenges Senator Christine Drazan to Three Debates Ahead of November Election
sources.snippet: The Tina for Oregon campaign challenged Christine Drazan to three 60-minute televised debates in Portland, Eugene, and Medford starting in September.

sources.title: Sen. Drazan accepts Central Oregon debate invite
sources.snippet: Drazan accepted KTVZ's invitation for a gubernatorial debate in Bend on October 13th. To date, Drazan has accepted invitations to six debates and one candidate forum: ONPA (Salem, July); Oregon Business & Industry Candidate Forum (Portland, September); KPTV/ODAA/OSSA/OACP (Portland, September); Oregon Journalism Project/UO/KVAL (Eugene, October); KOBI (Medford, October); KGW/The Oregonian (Portland, October). Published Aug 12, 2026.

sources.title: Sen Drazan accepts Portland debates
sources.snippet: Drazan has accepted invitations to two debates in Portland. The first will be hosted by KGW and The Oregonian in October. The second will be hosted by KPTV in partnership with the Oregon District Attorneys Association, the Oregon State Sheriffs Association and the Oregon Association Chiefs of Police in September. Published July 24, 2026.

sources.title: 2026 Oregon Competitiveness Summit & Gubernatorial Candidate Forum
sources.snippet: Thursday, September 24, 2026, 2:30pm - 5:30pm at the Sentinel, 614 SW 11th Ave, Portland. Oregon Business & Industry and Portland Business Journal will invite the major party candidates for Governor to participate in a forum discussion.

sources.title: Gov. Katie Hobbs declines debating Andy Biggs in governor's race
sources.snippet: The campaign team for Gov. Katie Hobbs announced Thursday that she will not debate GOP challenger Rep. Andy Biggs leading up to the November general election. Biggs' campaign said the GOP candidate will participate in the Clean Elections Debate on Oct. 6.

sources.title: Hobbs, Biggs won't debate before November Arizona governor election
sources.snippet: Arizonans won't get to see Katie Hobbs and Andy Biggs debate each other ahead of the November general election. Sexton did say that Biggs will participate in the debate being organized for Oct. 6 by the Citizens Clean Elections Commission. Tom Collins said no decision has been made yet whether the minor parties will be invited.

sources.title: Hobbs Rules Out Debates as Arizona Organizers Finalize Invitations
sources.snippet: Thomas Collins, executive director of the Clean Elections Commission, confirmed plans remain unsettled: 'The commission and the Arizona Media Association are still finalizing their plans on gubernatorial invitations.' Collins: 'I'm not pretending like Gov. Hobbs would come. She has to be considered an invitee even if she's going to decline.' Published Aug 5, 2026.

key_facts: BOTTOM LINE: As of Aug 19, 2026, no general-election gubernatorial debate has been held or is scheduled before September 2026 in Pennsylvania, Oregon, Arizona, or Wisconsin. All mutually-confirmed general-election governor debates in these four states are in October.

PENNSYLVANIA: Zero debates scheduled as of Aug 19, 2026 - no date, host, or format agreed. Both Shapiro and Garrity said in June they are willing to do 'at least one' debate, but no negotiations had begun as of Jun 23.

PENNSYLVANIA: Garrity called for seven debates on Jun 23, 2026, one in each PA media market (Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Harrisburg-Lancaster-Lebanon-York, Johnstown-Altoona, Wilkes-Barre/Scranton, Erie, Binghamton NY). Shapiro's campaign refused to negotiate terms through the press.

PENNSYLVANIA historical: 2022 Shapiro-Mastriano had ZERO debates; 2018 Wolf-Wagner had exactly ONE, at the PA Chamber Annual Dinner in October moderated by Alex Trebek. The 2026 PA Chamber Annual Dinner is Oct 5, 2026 at Hershey Lodge with Kevin Hart as keynote - no gubernatorial debate announced.

OREGON: Kotek and Drazan agreed on Jul 29, 2026 to two debates, BOTH in October - Oct 1 in Eugene (Oregon Journalism Project/UO/KEZI, tentative) and Oct 7 in Medford (KOBI-TV/Southern Oregon University, confirmed 7-8 p.m.).

OREGON: Kotek declined the Oregon Newspaper Publishers Association debate scheduled Jul 24, 2026 in Salem - traditionally the first debate of the general election. Drazan attended alone and spoke for over an hour; Kotek spent the day in Sisters for the Akawa Butte Fire.

OREGON: Two September events exist but only Drazan has accepted them - a KPTV/Oregon District Attorneys Association/Sheriffs/Chiefs of Police debate in Portland (September, date TBD) and the Oregon Business & Industry candidate forum (Sept 24, 2026, Portland). Kotek's campaign has not confirmed participation in either.

OREGON: Kotek's June 11 challenge proposed debates 'starting in September,' but by the July 29 agreement both confirmed debates had slipped to October. Drazan declined the KOIN Portland debate; Drazan has accepted six debates plus one forum total.

ARIZONA: Gov. Katie Hobbs announced Jul 30, 2026 she will not debate Andy Biggs at all. Campaign manager Nicole DeMont: 'face-to-face engagement with Arizonans is more effective than a stage designed for short soundbites and political theater.'

ARIZONA: The only scheduled gubernatorial general-election debate is the Citizens Clean Elections Commission debate on Oct 6, 2026. Biggs has committed; Hobbs is not expected to attend. Clean Elections ED Thomas Collins said Aug 5 the invitation list and format were still being finalized.

ARIZONA: The Clean Elections 2026 general debate calendar (published Apr 8, 2026) shows general debates starting Aug 24 (CD2), first statewide general debate Aug 31 (Mine Inspector), Attorney General Sept 23, Lt. Governor Oct 5, Governor Oct 6. No gubernatorial general debate was ever calendared before September.

ARIZONA historical: Arizona held a general-election gubernatorial debate every cycle from 1954 through 2018. Hobbs broke the streak in 2022 (refusing Kari Lake) and again in 2026. Her last televised debate was October 2018 in the secretary of state race.
WISCONSIN: As of Aug 18, 2026, spokespeople for both David Crowley (D) and Tom Tiffany (R) said they have NOT committed to any specific debate. Nominees were only settled by the Aug 11, 2026 primary.

WISCONSIN: Two general-election events are proposed but uncommitted - TMJ4 town hall Oct 8, 2026 at 6 p.m. (UW-Milwaukee Zelazo Center, announced March 2026) and Wisconsin Broadcasters Association debate Oct 9, 2026 at 7 p.m. (announced Aug 17, 2026, moderated by Jill Geisler).
WISCONSIN: The July 28, 2026 WISN-12 debate at Marquette University was a Democratic PRIMARY debate (5 candidates), not a general-election debate.
WISCONSIN historical: 2022 Evers-Michels had one debate on Oct 14 (25 days pre-election); 2018 Walker-Evers had two, Oct 19 and Oct 26; 2014 had two; 2010 had three. All in October.

NATIONAL: The earliest confirmed 2026 general-election gubernatorial debate found anywhere is South Dakota's State Fair debate in Huron during Sept 2-7, 2026 (Rhoden vs. Ahlers), with a second on Sept 28. Still September, not before.

NATIONAL: 2026 general-election gubernatorial debates cluster in October - Maine Oct 1/13/14, Arizona Oct 6, Georgia Oct 7 and Oct 12, Oregon Oct 1/7/13, Wisconsin Oct 8/9 (proposed), Florida Oct 15, Michigan October.

NATIONAL: Minnesota's Farmfest forum on Aug 5, 2026 in Morgan, MN was the closest pre-September cross-party event - DFL Sen. Amy Klobuchar shared a stage with three GOP candidates (Demuth, Lindell, Qualls) - but it was a pre-primary forum (MN primary Aug 11), not a two-nominee general-election debate.

PATTERN: In all four target states, the trailing/challenging candidate demands more debates (Garrity 7, Biggs accepts Oct 6, Drazan accepted 6) while the leading candidate commits to few or none - a structural asymmetry pushing debates late in the calendar.
